data.one_liner: ListView on mobile and stateless data tables on tablets and desktops.
data.what_it_does: Provides full-screen paginated data tables for tablets and desktops, and a mobile ListView with action buttons for sorting and selecting all. Supports dark mode and building from JSON.
use_when: You need a responsive table view that adapts between mobile lists and tablet/desktop data tables
You want a stateless data table without managing a complex DataSource
avoid_when: You only need a simple mobile list without desktop data table requirements
You require advanced grid features not supported by standard DataTables
strengths: Responsive layout switching between mobile and larger screens
Supports dark mode and optional custom mobile item builders
Includes features like sorting, pagination, and action buttons
weaknesses: Limited topic and community updates compared to newer packages
Relatively narrow scope focused entirely on responsive tables/lists
